notes: Plant wind case P10_rushes (Rushes row) written by scripts/build_plants.py: Four short stalks (as 10315 bamboo-stalk-3, with 32607 leaf plates) on 22484 ball joints in a row along the wind. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: rush_1: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-120.0, -12.0, 0.0] (real: 22484 ball in the 14418 friction socket (stalk as 10315 bamboo-stalk-3, its 30176 leaf bricks swapped for 32607 leaf plates); one tilt freedom used, about Z); rush_2: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-40.0, -12.0, 0.0] (real: 22484 ball in the 14418 friction socket (stalk as 10315 bamboo-stalk-3, its 30176 leaf bricks swapped for 32607 leaf plates); one tilt freedom used, about Z); rush_3: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [40.0, -12.0, 0.0] (real: 22484 ball in the 14418 friction socket (stalk as 10315 bamboo-stalk-3, its 30176 leaf bricks swapped for 32607 leaf plates); one tilt freedom used, about Z); rush_4: real revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [120.0, -12.0, 0.0] (real: 22484 ball in the 14418 friction socket (stalk as 10315 bamboo-stalk-3, its 30176 leaf bricks swapped for 32607 leaf plates); one tilt freedom used, about Z).
Real LEGO freedoms: rush_1, rush_2, rush_3, rush_4. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): none.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): rush_1 + = Rush 1 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); rush_2 + = Rush 2 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); rush_3 + = Rush 3 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X); rush_4 + = Rush 4 on its ball joint (real, 1 of 2 tilts); + leans it downwind (+X).

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
